whoItsFor: Creators, marketers, and developers who make short-form video (ads, TikTok/Reels/Shorts, podcast clips) and want AI coding agents to clone a reference video into an editable, re-runnable workflow and produce many variants.
useCases: Clone a viral TikTok, Reel, or Short into a template and swap the host, hook, or product
Ship many hook or ad variants of one composition, regenerating only the parts that change
Build podcast or interview clips with word-level captions, split-screen layouts, and B-roll
